title: Processor utilisation
note: Must be at most 1 on a single processor.

title: Liu and Layland bound (RM)
note: Sufficient test: 1.000, 0.828, 0.780, 0.757 for n = 1–4; tends to $\ln 2 \approx 0.693$.

title: Response-time analysis (RM)
note: Iterate from $R_i = C_i$ until it settles. Schedulable if $R_i \le D_i$.

title: Cyclic frame size
tex: f \ge \max_i C_i,\quad M \bmod f = 0,\quad 2f - \gcd(T_i, f) \le D_i
note: All three must hold for every task.

title: Nyquist criterion
note: Sample at least twice the highest frequency to avoid aliasing.

title: Latency budget
note: The total latency must be within the deadline.

title: Turnaround and waiting time
tex: TAT = C - A,\quad WT = TAT - B

title: Banker's need
note: Grant only if a safe sequence exists.

title: Little's law
note: Average number in the system = arrival rate × average time in the system.
